# Vulkan Memory Allocator (VMA), vendored

Unmodified copy of `include/vk_mem_alloc.h` and `LICENSE.txt` from
<https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/VulkanMemoryAllocator> at commit
`b3cbbb43ea3a506dffe10759e205a41c27c35ae2` (2026-03-02), an unreleased
3.4.0-development snapshot 46 commits after tag `v3.3.0`. MIT licensed, see
`LICENSE.txt`.

VMA is header only: define `VMA_IMPLEMENTATION` before the include in exactly
one translation unit.

To refresh, fetch both files from
`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/VulkanMemoryAllocator/<sha>/`
and update the commit above.
